userSpecifiedSources: MLIT Traffic Volume API (交通量API, reference values), data provided by the Japan Road Traffic Information Center (JARTIC, https://www.jartic-open-traffic.org/); place names from the GSI reverse geocoder (国土地理院); census_2021_counters.csv from the 2021 Road Traffic Census (令和3年度全国道路・街路交通情勢調査, MLIT, 公共データ利用規約 第1.0版), edited. Collected three times a day and built by https://github.com/yasumorishima/japan-road-traffic, which uploads a day only when every check passes.

census_2021_counters.csv.description: 365 permanent counters on national highways tied to their section of the 2021 Road Traffic Census (道路交通センサス, MLIT): route, lanes, speed limit and 2021 autumn weekday travel speeds. Join on (counter_id, sensor). The tie is inferred, not given by either source: see the match_ columns.

columns.counter_id: Counter ID (常時観測点コード); join with sensor
columns.census_section: Census section number (交通調査基本区間番号), 11 digits with its leading zero; read it as text
columns.route_number: National route number (一般国道 N 号); empty for a route the census numbers outside 1-507
columns.route_ja: Route name in the census (Japanese), with the bypass or road name in brackets when it has one
columns.route_en: Route in English, e.g. National Route 5
columns.observation_address_ja: Address of the census observation point (Japanese)
columns.observation_month: Month of the census observation (YYYY-MM; the road manager's permanent counter, several days)
columns.census_vol24_2021: Census 24-hour volume, both directions, vehicles: observed in autumn 2021 (for 2 sections observed for 12 hours and expanded by the census; for 1 section the census estimate from a 2020 survey)
columns.large12_pct_2021: Census daytime (7-19h) share of large vehicles, %
columns.peak_speed_up_kmh: 2021 autumn weekday average travel speed, km/h, rush hours (7-9h or 17-19h, whichever is congested), the 'up' direction (上り) (census, from ETC2.0 probe data); empty where the census did not measure it. A static 2021 value, not today's speed
columns.peak_speed_down_kmh: 2021 autumn weekday average travel speed, km/h, rush hours (7-9h or 17-19h, whichever is congested), the 'down' direction (下り) (census, from ETC2.0 probe data); empty where the census did not measure it. A static 2021 value, not today's speed
columns.offpeak_speed_up_kmh: 2021 autumn weekday average travel speed, km/h, daytime off-peak (9-17h), the 'up' direction (上り) (census, from ETC2.0 probe data); empty where the census did not measure it. A static 2021 value, not today's speed
columns.offpeak_speed_down_kmh: 2021 autumn weekday average travel speed, km/h, daytime off-peak (9-17h), the 'down' direction (下り) (census, from ETC2.0 probe data); empty where the census did not measure it. A static 2021 value, not today's speed
columns.match_km: Distance, km, between the counter and the geocoded census observation address (resolved to the town or a finer level; a pair resolved only to the municipality was left out)
columns.town_in_address: True when the counter's town name appears in the census observation address
columns.match_vol_ratio: Counter's September 2026 weekday median 24-hour volume / census 2021 volume; used to choose the section (kept between 0.86 and 1.16), not a measure of traffic growth

counters.csv.description: One row per counter (ID and sensor) seen in the API or the archive: location, prefecture, municipality and town (GSI reverse geocoder), and the last day it reported.

columns.counter_id: Counter ID (常時観測点コード)
columns.sensor: loop = permanent counter, cctv = AI count on CCTV images; (counter_id, sensor) is the key
columns.longitude: Longitude, WGS84, as given by the source
columns.latitude: Latitude, WGS84, as given by the source
columns.prefecture: Prefecture at the location (Japanese), from the GSI reverse geocoder
columns.prefecture_en: The same prefecture in English (Hokkaido, Tokyo, Osaka ...)
columns.municipality_code: Five-digit local government code (全国地方公共団体コード without the check digit) with its leading zero (01337); read it as text, e.g. pandas dtype={'municipality_code': str}
columns.municipality: City, ward, town or village at the location (Japanese)
columns.municipality_en: The same municipality in English, e.g. Yokohama-shi Tsurumi-ku, Nanae-cho (-shi city, -ku ward, -cho/-machi town, -mura/-son village): the name from Wikidata's English label without macrons, the type from the official reading in the MIC local government code list. Not unique (two towns can share a name): join on municipality_code
columns.town: Town or district name at the location (Japanese only: there is no official reading to romanise), from the GSI reverse geocoder; can be empty
columns.in_5min_box: True when the counter is inside the Kanto box that has five-minute data (longitude 138.4-140.95, latitude 34.85-37.2)
columns.last_seen: Latest day (JST) this counter reported in the API or in the archive

five_minute_kanto_2026-09_01-10.parquet.description: Five-minute vehicle counts for 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-10 (JST) inside the Kanto box (Tokyo, Kanagawa, Saitama, Chiba, Ibaraki, Tochigi, Gunma and edges): permanent and CCTV counters. One row per five minutes, counter and sensor.

columns.counter_id: Counter ID (常時観測点コード). The same ID can exist as a permanent counter and as a CCTV counter: the key is (counter_id, sensor); join counters.csv on both
columns.sensor: loop = permanent counter (loop or ultrasonic detector), cctv = AI count on CCTV images
columns.road_type: 1 = expressway (高速自動車国道) with an MLIT counter, 3 = national highway (一般国道)
columns.regional_bureau: Regional bureau number (地方整備局等番号): 81 Hokkaido, 82 Tohoku, 83 Kanto, 84 Hokuriku, 85 Chubu, 86 Kinki, 87 Chugoku, 88 Shikoku, 89 Kyushu, 90 Okinawa
columns.sub_region: Sub-region code (開発建設部／都道府県コード) as given by the source; empty outside Hokkaido and Chubu
columns.up_total: All vehicles in the interval, the 'up' direction (上り). CCTV counters only (the source gives it directly); empty for permanent counters, where it is up_small + up_large + up_unclassified
columns.up_small: Small vehicles in the interval, the 'up' direction (上り); empty when the source gives no value
columns.up_large: Large vehicles in the interval, the 'up' direction (上り); empty when the source gives no value
columns.up_unclassified: Vehicles whose size could not be told, the 'up' direction (上り)
columns.down_total: All vehicles in the interval, the 'down' direction (下り). CCTV counters only (the source gives it directly); empty for permanent counters, where it is down_small + down_large + down_unclassified
columns.down_small: Small vehicles in the interval, the 'down' direction (下り); empty when the source gives no value
columns.down_large: Large vehicles in the interval, the 'down' direction (下り); empty when the source gives no value
columns.down_unclassified: Vehicles whose size could not be told, the 'down' direction (下り)
columns.up_power_failure: Permanent counters: True when the source flags a power failure, the 'up' direction (上り); empty for CCTV
columns.up_loop_fault: Permanent counters: True when the source flags a loop detector fault, the 'up' direction (上り); empty for CCTV
columns.up_ultrasonic_fault: Permanent counters: True when the source flags an ultrasonic detector fault, the 'up' direction (上り); empty for CCTV
columns.up_missing: Permanent counters: True when the source flags the value as missing (欠測), the 'up' direction (上り); empty for CCTV
columns.down_power_failure: Permanent counters: True when the source flags a power failure, the 'down' direction (下り); empty for CCTV
columns.down_loop_fault: Permanent counters: True when the source flags a loop detector fault, the 'down' direction (下り); empty for CCTV
columns.down_ultrasonic_fault: Permanent counters: True when the source flags an ultrasonic detector fault, the 'down' direction (下り); empty for CCTV
columns.down_missing: Permanent counters: True when the source flags the value as missing (欠測), the 'down' direction (下り); empty for CCTV
columns.up_missing_processing: Hourly CCTV only: the source's 5分欠測処理フラグ, the 'up' direction (上り). The API specification defines 1 = five-minute processing and 2 = one hour; 0 also occurs and is not defined there. Kept as the integer code
columns.down_missing_processing: Hourly CCTV only: the source's 5分欠測処理フラグ, the 'down' direction (下り). The API specification defines 1 = five-minute processing and 2 = one hour; 0 also occurs and is not defined there. Kept as the integer code
columns.cam_preset_position: Five-minute CCTV rows only: True = camera is off its preset position (カメラプリセット位置); the source blanks the counts then, False = normal, empty = could not be judged or not a CCTV row
columns.cam_weather_degraded: Five-minute CCTV rows only: True = image degraded by weather (気象影響による映像不良), False = normal, empty = could not be judged or not a CCTV row
columns.cam_low_light: Five-minute CCTV rows only: True = not enough light (照度不足), False = normal, empty = could not be judged or not a CCTV row
columns.cam_incident: Five-minute CCTV rows only: True = incident such as a traffic accident (突発事象（交通事故等）), False = normal, empty = could not be judged or not a CCTV row
columns.cam_server_status: Five-minute CCTV rows only: True = server not running (サーバの稼働), False = normal, empty = could not be judged or not a CCTV row
columns.cam_feed_status: Five-minute CCTV rows only: True = video feed not received (カメラの映像受信), False = normal, empty = could not be judged or not a CCTV row
columns.cam_decode_status: Five-minute CCTV rows only: True = video decoding failed (映像のデコード処理), False = normal, empty = could not be judged or not a CCTV row
columns.cam_import_failure: Five-minute CCTV rows only: True = decoded video could not be passed to the analyser (取込加工処理の失敗), False = normal, empty = could not be judged or not a CCTV row
columns.cam_analyzer_freeze: Five-minute CCTV rows only: True = the image analyser froze (映像解析機能のフリーズ), False = normal, empty = could not be judged or not a CCTV row
columns.cam_other_error: Five-minute CCTV rows only: True = other error (その他エラー), False = normal, empty = could not be judged or not a CCTV row
columns.up_vehicles: Derived: all vehicles in the interval, the 'up' direction (上り), one column for both sensors. Permanent counters: up_small + up_large + up_unclassified, left empty when any of the four up_* fault/missing flags is set (a failed counter reports 0 or partial counts with a flag). CCTV counters: up_total as given (hourly CCTV rows with up_missing_processing = 1 can rest on incomplete five-minute data). Empty when the source gives no count
columns.down_vehicles: Derived: all vehicles in the interval, the 'down' direction (下り), one column for both sensors. Permanent counters: down_small + down_large + down_unclassified, left empty when any of the four down_* fault/missing flags is set (a failed counter reports 0 or partial counts with a flag). CCTV counters: down_total as given (hourly CCTV rows with down_missing_processing = 1 can rest on incomplete five-minute data). Empty when the source gives no count
columns.vehicles: Derived: up_vehicles + down_vehicles; empty when either is empty. Some counters count one direction only and report 0 for the other
columns.flagged: Derived, permanent counters only: True when any of the eight fault/missing flags (both directions) is set, False when none is; empty for CCTV rows
columns.weekday: Derived: day of the week of time_jst, 0 = Monday ... 6 = Sunday
columns.is_holiday: Derived: True on Japanese national holidays and substitute holidays (国民の祝日・休日), from the Cabinet Office list (内閣府「国民の祝日」CSV). Weekends are not marked; use weekday
columns.prefecture: Derived from counters.csv: prefecture at the counter's location (Japanese); empty for the few counters with no municipality in counters.csv (none found, or not resolved yet). Joining counters.csv gives prefecture_x / prefecture_y: drop one first
columns.prefecture_en: Derived: the same prefecture in English (Hokkaido, Tokyo, Osaka ...), from the JIS prefecture code in counters.csv municipality_code

columns.sub_region: Sub-region code (開発建設部／都道府県コード) as given by the source; empty outside Hokkaido and Chubu
columns.up_total: All vehicles in the interval, the 'up' direction (上り). CCTV counters only (the source gives it directly); empty for permanent counters, where it is up_small + up_large + up_unclassified

columns.up_large: Large vehicles in the interval, the 'up' direction (上り); empty when the source gives no value
columns.up_unclassified: Vehicles whose size could not be told, the 'up' direction (上り)
columns.down_total: All vehicles in the interval, the 'down' direction (下り). CCTV counters only (the source gives it directly); empty for permanent counters, where it is down_small + down_large + down_unclassified
columns.down_small: Small vehicles in the interval, the 'down' direction (下り); empty when the source gives no value
columns.down_large: Large vehicles in the interval, the 'down' direction (下り); empty when the source gives no value
columns.down_unclassified: Vehicles whose size could not be told, the 'down' direction (下り)
columns.up_power_failure: Permanent counters: True when the source flags a power failure, the 'up' direction (上り); empty for CCTV
columns.up_loop_fault: Permanent counters: True when the source flags a loop detector fault, the 'up' direction (上り); empty for CCTV
columns.up_ultrasonic_fault: Permanent counters: True when the source flags an ultrasonic detector fault, the 'up' direction (上り); empty for CCTV
columns.up_missing: Permanent counters: True when the source flags the value as missing (欠測), the 'up' direction (上り); empty for CCTV
columns.down_power_failure: Permanent counters: True when the source flags a power failure, the 'down' direction (下り); empty for CCTV
columns.down_loop_fault: Permanent counters: True when the source flags a loop detector fault, the 'down' direction (下り); empty for CCTV
columns.down_ultrasonic_fault: Permanent counters: True when the source flags an ultrasonic detector fault, the 'down' direction (下り); empty for CCTV
columns.down_missing: Permanent counters: True when the source flags the value as missing (欠測), the 'down' direction (下り); empty for CCTV

columns.down_missing_processing: Hourly CCTV only: the source's 5分欠測処理フラグ, the 'down' direction (下り). The API specification defines 1 = five-minute processing and 2 = one hour; 0 also occurs and is not defined there. Kept as the integer code
columns.cam_preset_position: Five-minute CCTV rows only: True = camera is off its preset position (カメラプリセット位置); the source blanks the counts then, False = normal, empty = could not be judged or not a CCTV row
columns.cam_weather_degraded: Five-minute CCTV rows only: True = image degraded by weather (気象影響による映像不良), False = normal, empty = could not be judged or not a CCTV row
columns.cam_low_light: Five-minute CCTV rows only: True = not enough light (照度不足), False = normal, empty = could not be judged or not a CCTV row
columns.cam_incident: Five-minute CCTV rows only: True = incident such as a traffic accident (突発事象（交通事故等）), False = normal, empty = could not be judged or not a CCTV row
columns.cam_server_status: Five-minute CCTV rows only: True = server not running (サーバの稼働), False = normal, empty = could not be judged or not a CCTV row
columns.cam_feed_status: Five-minute CCTV rows only: True = video feed not received (カメラの映像受信), False = normal, empty = could not be judged or not a CCTV row
columns.cam_decode_status: Five-minute CCTV rows only: True = video decoding failed (映像のデコード処理), False = normal, empty = could not be judged or not a CCTV row
columns.cam_import_failure: Five-minute CCTV rows only: True = decoded video could not be passed to the analyser (取込加工処理の失敗), False = normal, empty = could not be judged or not a CCTV row
columns.cam_analyzer_freeze: Five-minute CCTV rows only: True = the image analyser froze (映像解析機能のフリーズ), False = normal, empty = could not be judged or not a CCTV row
columns.cam_other_error: Five-minute CCTV rows only: True = other error (その他エラー), False = normal, empty = could not be judged or not a CCTV row
columns.up_vehicles: Derived: all vehicles in the interval, the 'up' direction (上り), one column for both sensors. Permanent counters: up_small + up_large + up_unclassified, left empty when any of the four up_* fault/missing flags is set (a failed counter reports 0 or partial counts with a flag). CCTV counters: up_total as given (hourly CCTV rows with up_missing_processing = 1 can rest on incomplete five-minute data). Empty when the source gives no count
columns.down_vehicles: Derived: all vehicles in the interval, the 'down' direction (下り), one column for both sensors. Permanent counters: down_small + down_large + down_unclassified, left empty when any of the four down_* fault/missing flags is set (a failed counter reports 0 or partial counts with a flag). CCTV counters: down_total as given (hourly CCTV rows with down_missing_processing = 1 can rest on incomplete five-minute data). Empty when the source gives no count
columns.vehicles: Derived: up_vehicles + down_vehicles; empty when either is empty. Some counters count one direction only and report 0 for the other
columns.flagged: Derived, permanent counters only: True when any of the eight fault/missing flags (both directions) is set, False when none is; empty for CCTV rows
columns.weekday: Derived: day of the week of time_jst, 0 = Monday ... 6 = Sunday
columns.is_holiday: Derived: True on Japanese national holidays and substitute holidays (国民の祝日・休日), from the Cabinet Office list (内閣府「国民の祝日」CSV). Weekends are not marked; use weekday
columns.prefecture: Derived from counters.csv: prefecture at the counter's location (Japanese); empty for the few counters with no municipality in counters.csv (none found, or not resolved yet). Joining counters.csv gives prefecture_x / prefecture_y: drop one first
columns.prefecture_en: Derived: the same prefecture in English (Hokkaido, Tokyo, Osaka ...), from the JIS prefecture code in counters.csv municipality_code
